prospective_76_78.draw76: Dropping any single raw FM subfeature still left the K22 at 6/6.
prospective_76_78.draw77: Dropping any single raw FM subfeature still left the K22 at 3/6.
prospective_76_78.draw78: Full K22 hit 5/6. Dropping lz reduced it to 4/6; all other single raw-feature drops stayed at 5/6.

interpretation: rz is the clearest current-regime marginal contributor: removing it materially hurts latest-50 mean hits and p4+.
lz is not strong as a standalone predictor, but it is the strongest tail-preservation component: removing it sharply degrades full-model 5+ cases in current and prior windows.
tz has useful standalone ranking signal, especially recently, but removing it from the hierarchy has only modest impact because other components partly substitute for it.
rp is regime-dependent: strong standalone in latest-50 but weak/negative over longer history; do not upweight based on the recent window alone.
dh carries some standalone information but its incremental contribution is modest and mixed.
ch is the weakest standalone component and appears mostly redundant, yet removing it can still damage some high-hit cases; no evidence supports deleting it now.

decision.next_research: If continuing, test a frozen recent-regime challenger that modestly increases rz influence while explicitly protecting lz tail contribution, then validate only prospectively / on untouched holdout windows.

caveat: Lottery outcomes are random; these historical attribution differences are descriptive and do not establish future predictability.
